theme.choiceHint: This choice applies to this browser.

language.title: Language
language.hint: This choice applies to this browser. Amounts stay in Brazilian reais.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: If you signed in on another device, such as a borrowed computer, you can end all sessions at once.
sessions.confirmText: You will be signed out of this and every other device you signed in on. To come back, sign in again.
sessions.error: Could not sign out of all devices.

account.title: Privacy and account
account.exportDescription: Download a copy of everything in your account: a .zip file with the full data (JSON) and your transactions as a spreadsheet (CSV, opens in Excel).
account.exportDone: File downloaded. It contains your financial data: keep it somewhere safe.
account.deleteDescription: Deleting your account permanently erases all your transactions, categories and vaults. It cannot be undone.
account.confirmText: All your data will be erased forever, on every device. To confirm, enter your password.
account.understand: I understand that all my data will be erased and that this cannot be undone.
account.confirmTextGoogle: All your data will be deleted forever, on every device. To confirm, sign in again with your Google account.

google.title: Google account
google.linked: You can sign in with Google or with your email and password.
google.linkedOnly: This account was created with Google and signs in only through it, because it has no password.
google.notLinked: Link a Google account to also sign in with it, without typing your password.
google.error: Could not change the Google link.
